summary.zh-Hans: 杭州西湖文化景观由西湖及三面环绕的群山组成，湖中有堤道和人工岛。它于2011年列入《世界遗产名录》。
summary.en: The West Lake cultural landscape includes the lake, hills on three sides, causeways and artificial islands. It joined the World Heritage List in 2011.

names.zh-Hans: 中国茶叶博物馆龙井馆区
names.en: China National Tea Museum, Longjing Branch

summary.zh-Hans: 中国茶叶博物馆以茶和茶文化为主题。龙井馆区位于翁家山，依山而建，周围有茶园。
summary.en: The China National Tea Museum explores tea and tea culture. Its Longjing branch is built on a hillside at Wengjiashan, surrounded by tea gardens.

summary.zh-Hans: 龙井虾仁是杭州地方菜，将虾仁与龙井茶的嫩芽一起烹制，成菜可见白色虾仁和绿色茶叶。
summary.en: This Hangzhou dish brings shrimp together with young Longjing tea leaves, pairing pale shrimp with green leaves on the plate.

summary.zh-Hans: 片儿川是杭州的特色面食，以雪菜、笋片和肉片搭配面条。
summary.en: Pian’erchuan is a Hangzhou noodle soup made with preserved mustard greens, sliced bamboo shoots and sliced pork.
